$comment: Ceilings for every shipped wasm artifact, read by `cargo xtask size` against the cargo artifact `cargo xtask dist wasm` ships (the release build with remapped paths, before wasm-bindgen and wasm-opt). Shrink-only: a ceiling more than the headroom above its artifact fails until lowered with `cargo xtask size --update`; raising one is a hand edit, and its reason says why the growth is worth it.

whiteboard-wasm.reason: abi_version(), the batched det exports (det_round among them), edge_route_on_grid from the routing spike, and the batched edge-primitive exports edge_segment_tests and edge_path_measures (ADR-0054 step 5's port of edge-geometry, segment-intersection, edge-ink, diagonal-ink and edge-rounding): 116654 bytes measured. The edge exports are the layer-2 differential's test surface, and nothing in the product loads this artifact yet (the core-wasm shim does not exist); they go when the one-call-per-layout export replaces them, which is when this ceiling is re-measured
